Do not provision or deploy Production
Do not execute real payments or public form submissions
Do not place secrets or live credentials in source, artifacts, logs, screenshots, or documentation

A redirect has exactly one approved target and one hop.
Raw WordPress technical routes require an explicit redirect or 410 decision.

migrationManifest.conflictRule: A target changed since planning becomes conflict and is never silently overwritten.

pipelineArtifact.promotionRule: The same application archive SHA-256 is promoted through Development, Staging, and separately authorized Production; environment configuration never rebuilds it.

tasks.title: Capture approved live baseline and executable route/content evidence
tasks.objective: Create repeatable no-submit crawl, screenshot, metadata, media, checksum, form/widget observation, and manifest capture tooling and capture the timestamped baseline.
commandsEvidence: Schema validation and retained screenshots/HTTP/SEO/media checksums
tasks.exitCriteria: All discoverable public routes/assets and named viewports are captured; dynamic/form unknowns are explicit residual risks; no form/payment is submitted.

tasks.title: Create solution foundation and land frozen contracts
tasks.objective: Create the .NET 10 solution, central build/package policy, projects, common contracts, module discovery, configuration validation, test scaffolds, and checked-in schemas.
tasks.exitCriteria: The empty modular solution builds/tests/publishes and later modules can add files without changing shared foundation.

tasks.title: Implement persistence and transaction foundation
tasks.objective: Provide EF Core SQL context, common concurrency/audit fields, configuration discovery, transactions/idempotency primitives, design-time tooling, and DB fixtures.
commandsEvidence: Integration tests against disposable SQL Server/Azure SQL-compatible instance
tasks.exitCriteria: Modules add discovered configurations without context edits and transaction/concurrency behavior is proven.

tasks.title: Implement Identity authorization and append-only audit
tasks.objective: Implement six roles/policies, MFA, disabled registration, deny-by-default endpoint/use-case authorization, account administration, and allowed/denied audit events.
commandsEvidence: Complete identity-by-capability role matrix integration suite
tasks.exitCriteria: Only matrix-authorized operations succeed and every permitted/denied privileged attempt is audited safely.

tasks.title: Implement immutable content and editorial lifecycle
tasks.objective: Implement content/navigation/religious revisions, preview, publish/unpublish/rollback, sanitization, Unicode checksums, and SEO fields.
tasks.exitCriteria: Published revisions are immutable, drafts do not leak, and rollback republishes as a new revision.

tasks.title: Implement events, programs, recurrence, and iCal
tasks.objective: Implement event/program states, recurrence occurrences, timezone-aware reads, editor lifecycle, and RFC-compliant iCal.
tasks.exitCriteria: Event lifecycle and public/iCal output are deterministic and canonical.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic prayer schedules and fallback
tasks.objective: Implement configurable Snohomish profiles, DST-aware sources/calculation, persisted snapshots, overrides, stale labels, and isolated failure behavior.
tasks.exitCriteria: Schedules are deterministic; overrides apply last; outages do not cascade.

tasks.title: Implement safe versioned media and stable aliases
tasks.objective: Implement Blob-backed immutable media versions, upload safety, stable aliases, range/ETag/cache behavior, and replace/archive workflow.
tasks.exitCriteria: Only safe files are served and approved stable paths survive replacement.

tasks.title: Implement persisted social snapshots and consent-safe feeds
tasks.objective: Implement provider normalization, local snapshots, refresh jobs/state, stale/empty/error states, and consent-controlled embed descriptors.
commandsEvidence: Assertion public reads never invoke provider
tasks.exitCriteria: Public social reads are local and failures return safe accessible state data.

tasks.title: Implement published-only search projection
tasks.objective: Implement SearchDocument projection, Azure SQL Full-Text query adapter, safe bounds/ranking/Unicode handling, and dependency-unavailable state.
tasks.exitCriteria: Search is bounded and can never expose drafts, admin, donor, or form data.

tasks.title: Implement contact and pledge submission workflows
tasks.objective: Implement versioned forms, durable submission/delivery jobs, duplicate/anti-abuse controls, retention, and non-public sinks.
tasks.exitCriteria: Invalid/bot inputs create no partial workflow; valid input creates one auditable record/job.

tasks.title: Implement Stripe Checkout and webhook-authoritative donations
tasks.objective: Implement configurable sandbox Checkout, read-only status pages, verified webhook authority, atomic idempotent completion/ledger, reconciliation, and privacy-safe operator views.
tasks.exitCriteria: Only verified webhooks complete donations; duplicate/concurrent events create one completion and ledger entry.

tasks.title: Build public shell, design system, content, and religious templates
tasks.objective: Reproduce shared shell/navigation/design tokens and content/religious/legal templates with responsive, keyboard, audio, and accessible states.
tasks.exitCriteria: Shared/content templates meet baseline tolerance with no horizontal overflow or serious accessibility issue.

tasks.title: Build calendar, prayer, and social public templates
tasks.objective: Build event/calendar/iCal, prayer, and social snapshot healthy/stale/empty/error public interfaces.
tasks.exitCriteria: All dynamic states are visually approved, accessible, and usable during provider faults.

tasks.title: Build media, search, forms, and donation public journeys
tasks.objective: Build gallery/lightbox/load-more, search, contact/pledge, and configurable sandbox donation public journeys.
tasks.exitCriteria: Named public journeys work without exposing private data or pre-consent tracking.

tasks.title: Implement URL, SEO, redirect, consent, and web security controls
tasks.objective: Implement route manifest enforcement, explicit endpoints, one-hop redirects, SEO feeds/metadata, versioned consent, CSP nonce, security headers, CSRF, and safe errors.
tasks.exitCriteria: Manifest statuses/canonicals match, optional scripts default off, and mandatory web controls pass.

tasks.title: Implement manifest-driven migration and reconciliation CLI
tasks.objective: Implement crawl/media and later WordPress adapters, canonical candidate planning, rights checks, dry-run, idempotent apply, conflicts, reconciliation, and reports.
commandsEvidence: Crawl and synthetic WP reconciliation reports
tasks.exitCriteria: Replay is non-destructive/idempotent and every candidate receives an accountable checksum-backed decision.

tasks.title: Consolidate relational schema and create initial migration
tasks.objective: Validate all entities, constraints, indexes, rowversions, and full-text setup; generate repeatable migration bundle/scripts and prove failure recovery.
tasks.exitCriteria: A clean DB reaches the complete schema repeatably and critical invariants are DB-enforced.

tasks.title: Implement durable jobs, health, telemetry, redaction, and operations controls
tasks.objective: Implement DB job leases/retries/dead letters, health/readiness, OpenTelemetry correlation, redaction, staleness metrics, retention workflows, and validated options.
tasks.exitCriteria: Failures are isolated/observable, logs are safe, and jobs recover after restart.

tasks.title: Define isolated Azure baseline with Bicep
tasks.objective: Define non-provisioning parameterized Development/Staging/Production App Service, SQL, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring, identity, health, alerts, and recovery capabilities without SKU selection.
tasks.exitCriteria: All stage templates validate and do not authorize SKU cost or deploy resources.

tasks.title: Implement PR and immutable promotion pipelines
tasks.objective: Implement CI quality/scanning/artifact creation and checksum-preserving Development/Staging/manual-Production promotion definitions with explicit migrations and gates.
tasks.exitCriteria: One artifact is built once, failed gates stop promotion, and Production remains manual/unexecuted.

tasks.title: Write developer, deployment, editor, security, and operations documentation
tasks.objective: Document setup, contracts, tests, sandbox configuration, migration, Azure stages, rollback, roles/editorial flows, privacy/security, alerts, restore, rotation, and emergency procedures.
tasks.exitCriteria: A new developer/operator can build, test, configure sandbox dependencies, diagnose failures, and locate constraints without secrets.

tasks.title: Independently validate automated and contract coverage
tasks.objective: Map every AC to executable evidence, add only missing system-validation tests, run all suites, and report reproducible defects.
tasks.exitCriteria: Every AC has named passing evidence or a blocking defect and unexplained skips are zero.

tasks.title: Perform independent security and privacy gate
tasks.objective: Threat-model and execute authorization, CSRF/CSP/header, upload, injection, secret, webhook, dependency, redaction, retention, and consent tests.
tasks.exitCriteria: APPROVED with no unresolved Critical/High, otherwise CHANGES_REQUIRED with evidence.

tasks.title: Perform independent principal code review
tasks.objective: Review correctness, architecture, maintainability, errors, concurrency, performance, and contract compatibility.
tasks.exitCriteria: APPROVED with no correctness or maintainability blocker.

tasks.title: Execute full end-to-end, accessibility, visual, and browser QA
tasks.objective: Exercise all public/editor/operator journeys, fault states, WCAG checks, pixel baselines, responsive widths, and required browser/device matrix.
tasks.exitCriteria: No severity-1/2 functional, visual, accessibility, security, or data-loss defect remains.

tasks.title: Rehearse non-production release readiness and recovery
tasks.objective: In authorized non-production only, prove immutable artifact identity, migration/failure gates, health/crawl/performance, backup/media restore, rollback, alerts, and release packet.
tasks.exitCriteria: Development/Staging evidence passes; Production remains unexecuted and separately authorized.

tasks.title: Independently judge the complete mission
tasks.objective: Verify R-01..R-54 and every applicable Definition of Done gate from real evidence, including residual export risk.
tasks.exitCriteria: APPROVED only when all requirements/gates are proven or exceptions have explicit CTO owner, expiry, risk, and acceptance.

waves.gate: G1: baseline schemas validate with no submitted form/payment; clean solution restore/build/test/publish passes; C1..C7 are checked in.

waves.parallel: T03 and T20 parallel; T21 starts after T20.
waves.gate: G2: persistence concurrency tests pass; Bicep compiles/lints without provisioning; artifact builder emits C6 layout and SHA.

waves.parallel: T04,T05,T06,T07,T08,T09,T11,T12,T19 fan out after T03; T10 starts after T05 and T06.
waves.gate: G3: module unit/integration suites prove role, idempotency, snapshot, upload, form, webhook, job, and redaction invariants.
G4: route/SEO/migration contracts pass; shared public shell meets initial visual/accessibility thresholds.
G5: complete schema applies; all public templates/journeys pass responsive, axe, visual, sandbox, and dependency-failure tests.
G6: documentation rehearsal and independent automated/security/code-review gates approve; failures create serialized module remediation.
G7: E2E/browser/WCAG/visual QA passes with no severity-1/2 defect.
G8: authorized Development/Staging-only release, restore, rollback, and identical checksum evidence passes; Production untouched.

nonBlockingCtoDecisionsBeforeProduction: Approve prayer baseline values and display tolerance.
Approve the captured donation modes/categories/form baseline.
Decide any costed Azure enhancement only if measured evidence requires it.
Accept quantified residual fidelity risk if no authorized WordPress export is available.
